## Problem And Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue, backlog item or functional requirement.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Explain omitted checks. For native code, include the build and RunnirTests results; for Go changes, include go test/vet/build. Documentation-only PRs may use link/content checks.

## Relevant Impact

Describe changed permissions, credential/data handling, filesystem scope, IPC contracts or dependencies when applicable. For UI work, link design/state references and add synthetic-content screenshots when useful. State limitations and unfinished work explicitly.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] Scope follows the agreed issue/MVP and preserves unrelated changes.
- [ ] Verification evidence matches the implementation; incomplete capabilities are labeled.
- [ ] No secrets, private repository content, personal data or raw crash/workflow logs are included.
- [ ] Applicable docs, tests, permissions/contracts and dependency notices are updated.
